subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should OpenClaw pursue A2UI canvas apps as dashboard widgets through the bundled dashboard bridge after browser Canvas action ingress lands, or should this be externalized/deferred?
rationale: The request spans product direction and a security boundary: it depends on an unmerged dashboard widget host and would let browser/sandboxed A2UI actions flow through trusted Gateway/dashboard paths.

options.title: Defer until prerequisites are approved
options.body: Keep this issue open, land or reject the browser Canvas action-ingress and dashboard substrate work first, then design one bridge against those approved contracts.

options.title: Make Canvas ingress canonical first
options.body: Prioritize https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/66983, then require the dashboard bridge to reuse that exact web A2UI action contract.

options.title: Externalize after API review
options.body: If bundled dashboard widgets are not core direction, route this to a ClawHub/plugin package only after any missing plugin APIs are approved.

recommendation.title: Defer until prerequisites are approved
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, land or reject the browser Canvas action-ingress and dashboard substrate work first, then design one bridge against those approved contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the clearest current-main routing signal for plugin-tab product direction and appears in both plugin-tab and Canvas history relevant to this bridge.
